Definition of PDM: Pain (>4 on NRS) associated with menstruation in the absence of organic pelvic disease, lasting >6 months
Exclusion of SDM: Organic pelvic disease visible by ultrasound
Other exclusion criteria: Irregular, short or long menstrual cycle; OCP use within 6 months; previous childbirth; inconsistent pain intensity

Definition of PDM: Recurrent painful menses within past 5 years that did not respond well to NSAIDs
Exclusion of SDM: Diagnosis of endometriosis, uterine myoma or adeno-myoma; gynaecological abnormality or pelvic pathology identified by clinical examination or ultrasound
Other exclusion criteria: Irregular, short or long menstrual cycle; history of surgery; hormonal, radio- or chemotherapy; serious psychiatric or medical disorder

Definition of PDM: Recurrent painful menses within past 5 years
Other exclusion criteria: Irregular, short or long menstrual cycle; history of pelvic surgery; GI, gynaecological or autoimmune disorders

Definition of PDM: Painful menstruation (≥5 on VAS for ≥1 year since menarche)
Exclusion of SDM: Trans-abdominal pelvic ultrasound used to exclude pelvic pathology
Other exclusion criteria: Obesity; previous pelvic surgery; neurological or psychiatric disorders; hormonal therapy within the past year

Definition of PDM: Pelvic or lower abdominal pain associated with menstruation during every period
Exclusion of SDM: Suspected organic pelvic disease due to i) heavy and irregular menses; ii) no response to NSAIDs; iii) pain not associated with menstruation
Other exclusion criteria: Surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, pregnancy, exogenous hormones or treatment for obstetric/gynaecological disease in past 3 months
